blocks.zh: 穩定性 - 藥品儲存與運輸的科學基礎
blocks.en: Stability: The Scientific Basis for Drug Product Storage and Transportation

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 Stability Data (穩定性數據) 如何決定藥品的儲存與運輸溫度條件
blocks.en: Understand how Stability Data determine the storage and shipping temperature conditions for drug products

blocks.zh: 掌握 Storage Temperature (儲存溫度) 監控的兩種形式及其實務要求
blocks.en: Master the two forms of Storage Temperature monitoring and their practical requirements

blocks.zh: 學習 Shipping Temperature (運輸溫度) 管理中的 Temperature Excursion (溫度偏移) 調查與處置流程
blocks.en: Learn the Temperature Excursion investigation and disposition process in Shipping Temperature management

blocks.zh: 了解 Mean Kinetic Temperature (MKT，平均動力學溫度) 在評估產品影響中的應用與限制
blocks.en: Understand the application and limitations of Mean Kinetic Temperature (MKT) in assessing product impact

blocks.zh: 認識 Stability Testing (穩定性測試) 如何支持包裝確效與 Time Out of Refrigeration (TOR) 時限管理
blocks.en: Understand how Stability Testing supports packaging qualification and Time Out of Refrigeration (TOR) limits

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Stability Studies (穩定性研究): 穩定性研究是藥品開發與生命週期管理的基石。它透過在不同溫度、濕度、光照條件下長期監測產品品質，來建立藥品的有效期 (shelf life) 及儲運條件。穩定性數據不僅決定了標籤上的儲存條件，更是整個供應鏈溫控策略的科學依據。
blocks.en: Stability Studies: Stability studies are the cornerstone of drug product development and lifecycle management. By monitoring product quality over time under different temperature, humidity and light conditions, they establish the shelf life and the storage and transportation conditions. Stability data not only determine the storage conditions on the label but also provide the scientific basis for the temperature control strategy of the entire supply chain.

blocks.zh: Good Distribution Practices (GDP，優良配銷規範): GDP 是確保藥品從製造商到最終使用者之間品質不受損害的一套規範。它涵蓋儲存、運輸、文件記錄等所有環節，與 GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) 互補，構成藥品品質保證的完整鏈條。
blocks.en: Good Distribution Practices (GDP): GDP is a set of requirements that ensures product quality is not compromised between the manufacturer and the end user. It covers all steps, including storage, transportation and documentation, and complements GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) to form a complete quality assurance chain for drug products.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你經營一家高級壽司店。壽司的新鮮度（產品穩定性）決定了你必須如何保存食材：鮪魚必須冷凍在 -20°C，鮭魚可以冷藏在 2-8°C，而醬油則可以常溫存放。如果你不做「保鮮實驗」（穩定性研究），就不知道食材在什麼溫度下能維持多久的品質，顧客可能吃到變質的壽司。GDP 就是確保「從漁港到餐桌」每一環節都能維持食材新鮮度的標準作業流程。
blocks.en: Imagine you run a high-end sushi restaurant. The freshness of the fish (product stability) dictates how you must store it: tuna must be frozen at -20°C, salmon can be refrigerated at 2-8°C, and soy sauce can be kept at room temperature. If you never ran "freshness experiments" (stability studies), you would not know how long each ingredient keeps its quality at a given temperature, and customers might be served spoiled sushi. GDP is the standard operating procedure that keeps the ingredients fresh at every step "from the fishing port to the dining table."

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 本章是 TR52 第三章「Requirements（要求事項）」的開頭。穩定性被放在最前面，正是因為它是所有後續儲運管理決策的科學基礎。沒有穩定性數據，就無法定義溫度範圍、運輸時限、偏移處理方案等關鍵參數。
blocks.en: This section opens Chapter 3, "Requirements," of TR52. Stability is placed first because it is the scientific basis for all later storage and transportation decisions. Without stability data, key parameters such as temperature ranges, transit time limits and excursion handling plans cannot be defined.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，穩定性數據的完整性直接影響能否為客戶提供合規的儲運服務。若客戶未能提供充足的穩定性數據，CDMO 在接受委託配銷時需特別謹慎，應在 Quality Agreement (品質協議) 中明確雙方責任。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, the completeness of stability data directly affects its ability to offer compliant storage and transportation services to clients. If a client does not provide sufficient stability data, the CDMO should be particularly cautious when accepting distribution work and should define each party's responsibilities clearly in the Quality Agreement.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼穩定性研究被安排在 GDP 要求事項的第一個章節？這反映了什麼樣的邏輯架構？
blocks.en: Why is stability placed in the first section of the GDP requirements? What logical structure does this reflect?

blocks.zh: 假設你是一家 CDMO 的品保主管，客戶委託你配銷一款新的生物製劑，但僅提供了長期穩定性數據（25°C/60%RH），未提供加速穩定性數據。你會如何處理？
blocks.en: Suppose you are the head of QA at a CDMO, and a client asks you to distribute a new biologic but provides only long-term stability data (25°C/60%RH) and no accelerated stability data. How would you handle this?

blocks.zh: 3.1.1 Storage Temperatures 儲存溫度
blocks.en: 3.1.1 Storage Temperatures

blocks.zh: Calibrated Temperature Recorders (經校正的溫度記錄器): 校正 (Calibration) 是指將監測設備的讀數與已知標準進行比對，確保其準確性。未經校正的溫度計就像一把刻度不準的尺，量出的數據毫無意義。校正必須定期執行，並保留可追溯的紀錄。
blocks.en: Calibrated Temperature Recorders: Calibration compares the readings of a monitoring device against a known standard to ensure its accuracy. An uncalibrated thermometer is like a ruler with inaccurate markings: the data it produces are meaningless. Calibration must be performed periodically and traceable records must be kept.

blocks.zh: Disposition-Based Review (基於處置的審查): 這是指在放行產品之前，必須先審查溫度數據以確認儲存條件是否符合要求。這不僅僅是「看一眼」溫度數據，而是要有系統性的審查流程，決定產品是否可以放行（disposition）。
blocks.en: Disposition-Based Review: Temperature data must be reviewed before a product is released to confirm that the storage conditions met the requirements. This is more than a "quick glance" at the data: a systematic review process is needed to decide whether the product can be released (disposition).

blocks.zh: Continuous Monitoring (連續監控): 指 24 小時不間斷地記錄溫度數據，與「定點抽查」相對。連續監控能捕捉到短暫的溫度波動，提供更完整的溫度履歷。
blocks.en: Continuous Monitoring: Temperature data are recorded 24 hours a day without interruption, as opposed to "spot checks." Continuous monitoring can capture brief temperature fluctuations and provides a more complete temperature history.

blocks.zh: Contingency Plan (應變計畫): 預先擬定的應急方案，用於處理設備故障、停電、極端天氣等可預見的異常事件。
blocks.en: Contingency Plan: A pre-established emergency plan for handling foreseeable abnormal events such as equipment failure, power outages and extreme weather.

blocks.zh: 儲存溫度管理就像醫院加護病房 (ICU) 的病人監護系統。ICU 不只是把病人放在房間裡，而是透過連續的生命體徵監測器（心電圖、血壓、血氧），即時掌握病人狀態。如果只是每隔幾小時量一次體溫，可能會錯過危險的體溫飆升。同樣地，倉庫的溫度監控如果不是連續的，就可能漏掉一段冷氣故障導致的溫度偏移。而「應變計畫」就像 ICU 的急救流程 -- 護理師在監測到異常時，不需要臨時想該怎麼辦，因為標準流程早已制定好。
blocks.en: Storage temperature management is like the patient monitoring system in a hospital intensive care unit (ICU). An ICU does not simply put the patient in a room; continuous vital sign monitors (ECG, blood pressure, blood oxygen) track the patient's condition in real time. If body temperature were taken only every few hours, a dangerous spike could be missed. Likewise, if warehouse temperature monitoring is not continuous, a temperature excursion caused by an air-conditioning failure could go undetected. The "contingency plan" is like the ICU emergency protocol: when nurses detect an abnormality, they do not have to improvise, because the standard procedure was established long ago.

blocks.zh: 「所有部位」(all parts) 的要求： 文件特別強調溫度管控必須涵蓋相關區域的「所有部位」。這意味著僅在倉庫中央放置一個溫度計是不夠的。大型倉庫可能存在溫度不均勻的「死角」（例如靠近門口、天花板附近、靠近暖氣管路等），必須透過 Temperature Mapping (溫度分佈驗證) 來識別這些熱點/冷點，並據此佈置足夠的監測點。
blocks.en: The "all parts" requirement: The document specifically emphasizes that temperature control must cover "all parts" of the relevant area. A single thermometer placed in the middle of a warehouse is therefore not enough. Large warehouses may have "dead spots" with uneven temperatures (for example near doors, near the ceiling or near heating pipes), so Temperature Mapping must be performed to identify these hot and cold spots, and a sufficient number of monitoring points must be placed accordingly.

blocks.zh: 兩種監控形式的關係： 文件列出「連續監控」和「主動式自動警報系統」兩種形式，要求至少具備其一。實務上，最佳做法是兩者兼備 -- 連續記錄提供完整的溫度履歷用於放行審查，而自動警報則確保異常發生時能即時應對。
blocks.en: Relationship between the two forms of monitoring: The document lists "continuous monitoring" and "active automated alarm systems" as two forms, and at least one of them is required. In practice, the best approach is to have both: continuous recording provides a complete temperature history for disposition review, while automated alarms ensure an immediate response when an abnormality occurs.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，倉庫溫度管理是日常營運的核心能力之一。以下是實務中常見的挑戰：
blocks.en: For a CDMO, warehouse temperature management is one of the core capabilities of daily operations. Common practical challenges include:

blocks.zh: 多客戶、多溫區管理： CDMO 同時儲存不同客戶的產品，可能需要 2-8°C、15-25°C、-20°C 等多個溫區。每個溫區都需要獨立的監控系統和校正計畫。
blocks.en: Multiple clients and multiple temperature zones: A CDMO stores products for different clients at the same time and may need zones such as 2-8°C, 15-25°C and -20°C. Each zone needs its own monitoring system and calibration program.

blocks.zh: Carrier Qualification (承運商確效)： 應變計畫需要與「核准的承運商」(approved carrier) 共同制定，這意味著 CDMO 必須先完成承運商的確效工作。
blocks.en: Carrier Qualification: The contingency plan must be developed together with the "approved carrier," which means the CDMO must first complete the qualification of the carrier.

blocks.zh: 數據完整性： 溫度紀錄屬於 GxP 數據，必須符合 ALCOA+ 原則（Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate）。電子化的溫度監控系統需通過 CSV (Computer System Validation) 確效。
blocks.en: Data integrity: Temperature records are GxP data and must comply with the ALCOA+ principles (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate). Electronic temperature monitoring systems must be validated through CSV (Computer System Validation).

blocks.zh: 你的倉庫有一台溫度記錄器在校正過期後的三天才被發現。在這三天內存放的產品已經出貨。你會如何處理這個偏差？
blocks.en: A temperature recorder in your warehouse is found to have been out of calibration for three days, and the products stored during those three days have already been shipped. How would you handle this deviation?

blocks.zh: 為什麼文件要求「紀錄應在每次操作當時完成」(records should be made at the time each operation is done)？如果隔天再補填紀錄，會有什麼風險？
blocks.en: Why does the document require that "records should be made at the time each operation is done"? What are the risks of filling in records the next day?

blocks.zh: 一個 10,000 平方英尺的冷藏倉庫，你認為至少需要多少個溫度監測點？決定監測點數量的依據是什麼？
blocks.en: For a 10,000 square foot cold storage warehouse, what is the minimum number of temperature monitoring points you would consider necessary? On what basis would you decide the number of monitoring points?

blocks.zh: 3.1.2 Shipping Temperatures 運輸溫度
blocks.en: 3.1.2 Shipping Temperatures

blocks.zh: Temperature Excursion (溫度偏移): 指產品暴露在超出規定溫度範圍之外的事件。偏移可以是短暫的（如開門通風數分鐘），也可以是長時間的（如冷鏈中斷數小時）。關鍵在於評估偏移對產品品質的影響。
blocks.en: Temperature Excursion: An event in which a product is exposed to temperatures outside the specified range. An excursion can be short (for example a few minutes of door opening for ventilation) or prolonged (for example several hours of cold chain interruption). The key is to assess the impact of the excursion on product quality.

blocks.zh: Shipping Range vs. Label Storage Conditions (運輸範圍 vs. 標籤儲存條件): 這是一個非常重要的區別。標籤上的儲存條件（如 2-8°C）是長期儲存的要求，而運輸溫度範圍可以更寬鬆（如 2-25°C），前提是有穩定性數據支持短期暴露在較寬範圍內不會影響品質。
blocks.en: Shipping Range vs. Label Storage Conditions: This is a very important distinction. The storage conditions on the label (for example 2-8°C) are requirements for long-term storage, while the shipping temperature range can be wider (for example 2-25°C), provided that stability data support the conclusion that short-term exposure to the wider range does not affect quality.

blocks.zh: Cumulative Temperature Excursions (累積溫度偏移): 不只考慮單次偏移事件，還需評估整個供應鏈中所有溫度偏移的累積效應。例如，產品在製造廠出庫時有 1 小時暴露在 15°C，運輸途中又有 2 小時暴露在 20°C，這些都需要累積計算。
blocks.en: Cumulative Temperature Excursions: Consider not only individual excursion events but also the cumulative effect of all temperature excursions across the whole supply chain. For example, if a product is exposed to 15°C for 1 hour when leaving the manufacturing site and to 20°C for 2 hours in transit, these exposures must be added up.

blocks.zh: Arrhenius Equation (阿瑞尼斯方程式): 一個描述化學反應速率與溫度關係的方程式。在藥品穩定性領域，它被用來預測不同溫度下的降解速率，是 MKT 計算的理論基礎。
blocks.en: Arrhenius Equation: An equation describing the relationship between chemical reaction rate and temperature. In the field of drug stability, it is used to predict degradation rates at different temperatures and is the theoretical basis for the MKT calculation.

blocks.zh: Mean Kinetic Temperature (MKT，平均動力學溫度): 一個用於評估溫度波動對產品影響的計算工具。MKT 考慮了溫度變化的「不對稱性」-- 高溫對降解的促進效果大於低溫對降解的抑制效果。它將不穩定的溫度曲線轉換為一個「等效恆溫」，便於評估產品是否受到影響。
blocks.en: Mean Kinetic Temperature (MKT): A calculated value used to assess the effect of temperature fluctuations on a product. MKT accounts for the "asymmetry" of temperature changes: high temperatures accelerate degradation more than low temperatures slow it. It converts a varying temperature profile into a single "equivalent isothermal temperature," making it easier to assess whether the product has been affected.

blocks.zh: 運輸溫度管理就像一場接力賽。每一棒（供應鏈的每一環節）都有自己的「容許犯錯空間」。穩定性研究就是事先計算好：整場比賽中，總共能承受多少秒的失誤（累積偏移時間），以及每一棒最多能慢多少秒（每段的偏移預算）。
blocks.en: Shipping temperature management is like a relay race. Each leg (each link of the supply chain) has its own "room for error." A stability study works out in advance how many seconds of total error the whole race can tolerate (cumulative excursion time) and how many seconds each leg can lose at most (the excursion budget for each segment).

blocks.zh: MKT 就像一場考試的「加權平均分」。如果你考了幾次高溫（難的科目）和幾次低溫（容易的科目），MKT 不是簡單的算術平均，而是更偏向高溫那一邊的加權結果 -- 因為高溫對藥品的傷害就像難科目的低分，影響更大。
blocks.en: MKT is like the "weighted average score" of an exam. If you sat several exams in high-temperature subjects (hard) and several in low-temperature subjects (easy), MKT is not a simple arithmetic mean but a weighted result that leans toward the high-temperature side, because heat harms a drug product the way a low mark in a hard subject hurts your average, and its impact is greater.

blocks.zh: 免除運輸監控的條件： 文件允許在兩種情況下免除運輸途中的溫度監控：(1) 透過 Temperature Mapping 證明運輸條件不會超出要求；(2) 使用已確效的包裝容器 (Qualified Packaging Containers)。這給了業界彈性，但需要紮實的確效數據支持。
blocks.en: Conditions for waiving in-transit monitoring: The document allows in-transit temperature monitoring to be waived in two cases: (1) Temperature Mapping demonstrates that shipping conditions will not exceed the requirements; or (2) Qualified Packaging Containers are used. This gives the industry flexibility, but it must be supported by solid qualification data.

blocks.zh: MKT 的使用限制： 文件特別註明需確認當地法規是否允許使用 MKT。這是因為 MKT 有其適用前提 -- 降解必須遵循 Arrhenius 模型（即單一速率決定步驟的化學降解）。對於某些生物製劑，蛋白質聚集等物理降解途徑可能不符合 Arrhenius 假設，此時 MKT 可能不適用。
blocks.en: Limitations on the use of MKT: The document specifically notes that you must confirm whether local regulations permit the use of MKT. This is because MKT has a precondition: degradation must follow the Arrhenius model (that is, chemical degradation governed by a single rate-determining step). For some biologics, physical degradation pathways such as protein aggregation may not fit the Arrhenius assumption, and MKT may then not be applicable.

blocks.zh: 偏移調查三要素： 發生溫度偏移時，必須調查 (1) 根本原因、(2) 矯正措施、(3) 產品影響。這三者缺一不可，且產品影響的評估必須有書面文件記錄。
blocks.en: Three elements of an excursion investigation: When a temperature excursion occurs, you must investigate (1) the root cause, (2) corrective actions and (3) the product impact. None of the three can be omitted, and the product impact assessment must be documented in writing.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula
blocks.en: Formula

blocks.zh: Arrhenius Equation (阿瑞尼斯方程式):
blocks.en: Arrhenius Equation:

blocks.zh:
k = A × e^(-Ea/RT)

k  = 反應速率常數 (reaction rate constant)
A  = 頻率因子 (pre-exponential factor)
Ea = 活化能 (activation energy, kJ/mol)
R  = 氣體常數 (8.314 J/mol·K)
T  = 絕對溫度 (absolute temperature, K)
blocks.en:
k = A × e^(-Ea/RT)

k  = reaction rate constant
A  = pre-exponential factor
Ea = activation energy (kJ/mol)
R  = gas constant (8.314 J/mol·K)
T  = absolute temperature (K)

blocks.zh: MKT 計算概念：
blocks.en: MKT calculation concept:

blocks.zh:
MKT = (ΔH/R) / ln[(e^(-ΔH/RT1) + e^(-ΔH/RT2) + ... + e^(-ΔH/RTn)) / n]

ΔH = 活化能 (通常假設為 83.144 kJ/mol)
T1...Tn = 各時間點的絕對溫度 (K)
n = 溫度測量點數
blocks.en:
MKT = (ΔH/R) / ln[(e^(-ΔH/RT1) + e^(-ΔH/RT2) + ... + e^(-ΔH/RTn)) / n]

ΔH = activation energy (usually assumed to be 83.144 kJ/mol)
T1...Tn = absolute temperature at each time point (K)
n = number of temperature measurement points

blocks.zh: MKT 的值總是大於或等於算術平均溫度，因為它對高溫給予更大的權重。
blocks.en: The MKT value is always greater than or equal to the arithmetic mean temperature, because it gives greater weight to high temperatures.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 的供應鏈團隊而言，3.1.2 節是日常運營中最常遇到的管理議題之一：
blocks.en: For a CDMO's supply chain team, Section 3.1.2 covers one of the management issues encountered most often in daily operations:

blocks.zh: Temperature Excursion Budget (溫度偏移預算): 與客戶協商時，應在 Quality Agreement 中明確各供應鏈環節的偏移預算分配。例如，總計可接受 72 小時的 15-25°C 暴露，其中製造端佔 24 小時、倉儲端佔 24 小時、運輸端佔 24 小時。
blocks.en: Temperature Excursion Budget: When negotiating with clients, the allocation of the excursion budget to each supply chain segment should be defined in the Quality Agreement. For example, a total of 72 hours of exposure at 15-25°C may be acceptable, split into 24 hours at the manufacturing site, 24 hours in storage and 24 hours in transportation.

blocks.zh: Deviation Management (偏差管理): 每次溫度偏移都必須開偏差報告，評估產品影響、執行 CAPA。高頻率的偏移事件可能反映系統性問題（設備老化、承運商管理不善等），需要進行趨勢分析。
blocks.en: Deviation Management: Every temperature excursion must be raised as a deviation, with an assessment of product impact and CAPA implemented. A high frequency of excursion events may point to systemic problems (aging equipment, poor carrier management and so on) and requires trend analysis.

blocks.zh: Lane Qualification (運輸路線確效): 不同運輸路線（如台灣到美國 vs. 台灣到歐洲）面臨不同的氣候挑戰，可能需要不同的包裝方案和監控策略。
blocks.en: Lane Qualification: Different shipping lanes (for example Taiwan to the US vs. Taiwan to Europe) face different climate challenges and may require different packaging solutions and monitoring strategies.

blocks.zh: 一批標籤標示 2-8°C 儲存的生物製劑在運輸途中被記錄到 12°C 持續 4 小時。客戶的穩定性數據僅支持 15°C 以下短期暴露。你認為這批產品是否可以放行？你需要哪些額外資訊來做出判斷？
blocks.en: A batch of a biologic labeled for storage at 2-8°C is recorded at 12°C for 4 hours during transportation. The client's stability data support only short-term exposure below 15°C. Do you think this batch can be released? What additional information do you need to make that judgment?

blocks.zh: 為什麼穩定性數據需要「分配到各供應鏈環節」(allocated into the various supply chain segments)？如果不做這樣的分配，會有什麼風險？
blocks.en: Why do stability data need to be "allocated into the various supply chain segments"? What are the risks of not doing this?

blocks.zh: 在什麼情況下，MKT 可能不是評估溫度偏移影響的合適工具？試舉出至少兩個例子。
blocks.en: Under what circumstances might MKT not be a suitable tool for assessing the impact of a temperature excursion? Give at least two examples.

blocks.zh: 3.1.3 Stability Testing to Support Distribution 支持配銷的穩定性測試
blocks.en: 3.1.3 Stability Testing to Support Distribution

blocks.zh: Qualified Packaging (確效包裝): 指經過正式測試和驗證、證明能在規定條件下維持溫度範圍的包裝系統。確效過程通常包括在模擬最差情況（夏季高溫、冬季嚴寒）下的溫度維持測試。包裝確效是一次性的（除非設計變更），但需要定期重新評估。
blocks.en: Qualified Packaging: A packaging system that has been formally tested and verified to maintain the temperature range under specified conditions. The qualification process usually includes temperature-hold testing that simulates worst-case conditions (summer heat, winter cold). Packaging qualification is a one-time exercise (unless the design changes), but periodic reassessment is needed.

blocks.zh: Time Out of Refrigeration (TOR，離開冷藏時間): 指需要冷藏的產品在 2-8°C 以外環境中暴露的累積時間。TOR 的上限必須由穩定性數據支持。例如，某產品的 TOR 限制為「累計不超過 24 小時在 15-25°C」。TOR 管理是冷鏈物流中最常見的操作控制之一。
blocks.en: Time Out of Refrigeration (TOR): The cumulative time that a product requiring refrigeration is exposed to conditions outside 2-8°C. The TOR limit must be supported by stability data. For example, a product's TOR limit might be "no more than 24 hours cumulative at 15-25°C." TOR management is one of the most common operational controls in cold chain logistics.

blocks.zh: Validation Master Plan (VMP，確效主計畫): 一份高層級的策略文件，概述組織的整體確效策略，包括哪些系統需要確效、確效的方法和範圍、時間表等。包裝確效應被納入 VMP 中統一管理。
blocks.en: Validation Master Plan (VMP): A high-level strategy document that outlines the organization's overall validation strategy, including which systems require validation, the approach and scope of validation, and timelines. Packaging qualification should be included in the VMP so that it is managed in a unified way.

blocks.zh: Risk-Based Approach (基於風險的方法): 確效的深度和廣度應與風險程度成正比。高敏感性產品（如某些生物製劑、疫苗）需要更嚴格的包裝確效；而較穩定的產品（如某些固體口服劑型）可能只需要較簡單的驗證。
blocks.en: Risk-Based Approach: The depth and breadth of validation should be proportional to the level of risk. Highly sensitive products (such as some biologics and vaccines) require more rigorous packaging qualification, while more stable products (such as some oral solid dosage forms) may need only simpler verification.

blocks.zh: 包裝確效就像測試一個保溫便當盒的性能。你買了一個號稱「保溫 6 小時」的便當盒，但你不能只看廣告就相信。你需要在最惡劣的條件下實測：夏天 35°C 的室外、冬天 -5°C 的戶外，看看便當盒是否真的能維持食物在安全溫度範圍內。而 TOR 就像你知道便當離開冰箱後，在室溫下最多可以放多久還能安全食用。超過這個時間，就算外觀沒變，你也不敢再吃了。
blocks.en: Packaging qualification is like testing the performance of an insulated lunch box. You buy a lunch box that claims to "keep food warm for 6 hours," but you cannot simply trust the advertisement. You need to test it under the harshest conditions: outdoors at 35°C in summer and at -5°C in winter, to see whether it really keeps the food within a safe temperature range. TOR is like knowing how long a lunch can sit at room temperature after leaving the refrigerator and still be safe to eat. Beyond that time, even if it looks unchanged, you would not dare to eat it.

blocks.zh: 包裝的雙重功能： 本節指出包裝必須同時提供 (1) 物理保護（防止機械衝擊造成的損壞）和 (2) 溫度保護（維持適當的溫度範圍）。在選擇包裝方案時，兩者必須同時考量。
blocks.en: The dual function of packaging: This section points out that packaging must provide both (1) physical protection (preventing damage from mechanical shock) and (2) temperature protection (maintaining the appropriate temperature range). Both must be considered when selecting a packaging solution.

blocks.zh: 運輸方式與目的地的影響： 文件特別強調運輸方式（陸運、海運、空運）和目的地（氣候條件）都會影響包裝設計。例如，從台灣空運到中東的包裝需求與陸運到日本截然不同。夏季和冬季也可能需要不同的包裝方案（夏季防熱、冬季防凍）。
blocks.en: Influence of transport mode and destination: The document specifically emphasizes that both the mode of transport (road, sea, air) and the destination (climate conditions) affect packaging design. For example, the packaging needed for air freight from Taiwan to the Middle East is quite different from that for road transport to Japan. Summer and winter may also call for different packaging solutions (heat protection in summer, freeze protection in winter).

blocks.zh: Service Level Agreement (SLA) 與 Quality Agreement (QA) 的角色： TOR 時限不僅需要穩定性數據的科學支持，還需要在商業協議 (SLA) 或品質協議 (QA) 中明確約定。這確保了供應鏈中的每個參與者都清楚自己的責任和限制。
blocks.en: The role of the Service Level Agreement (SLA) and the Quality Agreement (QA): TOR limits need not only scientific support from stability data but also a clear agreement in the commercial agreement (SLA) or the Quality Agreement (QA). This ensures that every participant in the supply chain understands its own responsibilities and limits.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，3.1.3 節的要求直接影響包裝設計、物流成本和客戶服務品質：
blocks.en: For a CDMO, the requirements of Section 3.1.3 directly affect packaging design, logistics cost and the quality of customer service:

blocks.zh: 包裝確效的投資回報： 一套完整的冷鏈包裝確效（含夏季/冬季 profile、不同運輸時間模擬）可能需要 3-6 個月和數十萬元的投資，但它是合規的必要條件，也能減少因包裝失效導致的產品損失。
blocks.en: Return on investment in packaging qualification: A complete cold chain packaging qualification (including summer and winter profiles and simulations of different transit times) can take 3-6 months and an investment of several hundred thousand (local currency). It is a necessary condition for compliance, and it also reduces product losses caused by packaging failure.

blocks.zh: TOR 管理系統： 大型 CDMO 通常需要建立電子化的 TOR 追蹤系統，記錄每次產品離開冷藏的時間，並在接近上限時發出警報。這尤其重要的是在 Pack-out (包裝出貨) 作業期間。
blocks.en: TOR management system: Large CDMOs usually need an electronic TOR tracking system that records every time a product leaves refrigeration and issues an alarm when the limit is approached. This is especially important during Pack-out operations.

blocks.zh: 季節性包裝策略： 許多 CDMO 會維護「夏季包裝」和「冬季包裝」兩套方案。過渡季節的切換時機需要根據歷史氣象數據和路線分析來決定。
blocks.en: Seasonal packaging strategy: Many CDMOs maintain two packaging solutions, a "summer pack" and a "winter pack." The timing of the switch during transitional seasons should be decided on the basis of historical weather data and lane analysis.

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 打算從台灣出貨一批需要 2-8°C 儲存的注射劑到巴西。在規劃包裝確效方案時，你會考慮哪些因素？（提示：運輸時間、轉運點、季節、海關停留時間等）
blocks.en: A CDMO plans to ship a batch of injectable products requiring 2-8°C storage from Taiwan to Brazil. What factors would you consider when planning the packaging qualification program? (Hint: transit time, transshipment points, season, customs dwell time, etc.)

blocks.zh: 為什麼文件強調包裝確效方法應「基於風險」(based on risk)？如果對所有產品都採用相同等級的包裝確效，會有什麼問題？
blocks.en: Why does the document emphasize that the packaging qualification approach should be "based on risk"? What problems would arise if the same level of packaging qualification were applied to all products?

blocks.zh: 在 Quality Agreement 中，關於 TOR 管理，製造商和配銷商各自應承擔哪些責任？試列出至少三項各方的責任。
blocks.en: In the Quality Agreement, what responsibilities should the manufacturer and the distributor each take on for TOR management? List at least three responsibilities for each party.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 穩定性數據是 GDP 的基石： 所有儲存溫度、運輸溫度、偏移評估、包裝確效的決策，都必須建立在穩定性數據的科學基礎之上。
blocks.en: Stability data are the cornerstone of GDP: All decisions on storage temperature, shipping temperature, excursion assessment and packaging qualification must be built on the scientific basis of stability data.

blocks.zh: 儲存溫度監控的雙要素： 至少需要連續監控或自動警報系統之一，且監控設備必須定期校正，所有紀錄必須即時、可追溯。
blocks.en: Two elements of storage temperature monitoring: At least one of continuous monitoring or an automated alarm system is required, monitoring equipment must be calibrated periodically, and all records must be contemporaneous and traceable.

blocks.zh: 運輸溫度可以不同於標籤儲存條件： 但必須有穩定性數據或科學論述支持，且需考慮累積偏移效應，MKT 可作為評估工具但有使用限制。
blocks.en: Shipping temperatures may differ from label storage conditions: but they must be supported by stability data or a scientific rationale, the cumulative effect of excursions must be considered, and MKT can be used as an assessment tool but has limitations.

blocks.zh: 偏移調查三要素： 根本原因、矯正措施、產品影響評估，三者缺一不可，且須經品質部門核准。
blocks.en: Three elements of an excursion investigation: Root cause, corrective actions and product impact assessment; none of the three can be omitted, and they must be approved by the quality unit.

blocks.zh: 包裝確效須基於風險： 考慮產品的溫度敏感性、運輸方式、目的地氣候等因素，確效結果需納入 Validation Master Plan。
blocks.en: Packaging qualification must be risk-based: Consider factors such as the product's temperature sensitivity, transport mode and destination climate, and incorporate the qualification results into the Validation Master Plan.

blocks.zh: TOR 管理是冷鏈物流的關鍵操作控制： 時限必須由穩定性數據支持，並在 Quality Agreement 中明確約定各方責任。
blocks.en: TOR management is a key operational control in cold chain logistics: Limits must be supported by stability data, and each party's responsibilities must be clearly agreed in the Quality Agreement.
